name: Bona Film Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Bona Film Group Co., Ltd. is a prominent Chinese entertainment conglomerate established in Beijing in 2003. The company's diverse operations include the full lifecycle of film and television content, from production and investment to distribution. It also maintains a substantial presence in the exhibition industry, operating 80 cinemas equipped with 662 screens across major Chinese urban centers like Beijing, Shanghai, Hangzhou, Ningbo, and Chongqing. Beyond its core media and cinema endeavors, Bona Film Group offers advertising and marketing services, alongside artist management.
